preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000.
The number of allowed letters is between 1 and 26.
The length of the string s matches the given length n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= chr(ord('a') + p - 1) for char in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is one of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == s[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: s does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all('a' <= char <= chr(ord('a') + p - 1) for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is one of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or not any(return_value[i] == return_value[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The output string does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2.
The output string is lexicographically larger than the input string s.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(any(return_value[j] != return_value[j+1] for j in range(i, n-1)) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The output string does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.
